title: Great Idea Executed Poorly
text:
Great Idea Executed Poorly. The concept is a great one: Keep the part of your spoons and forks that goes into your mouth from touching table or counter-top surfaces. (And keep the part of your knife that touches food from doing the same.)

Sadly, their idea to keep this from happening disappointed me a great deal. The silverware is just too heavy, in my opinion. I found them uncomfortable to hold and use.

Perhaps it might have been a better idea to just put a tiny stem underneath the silverware to keep the front propped up when resting on a surface, at the same time keeping the rest of the silverware nice and thin & lightweight, which a lot of people might prefer.

I cannot personally recommend the Yamazaki Float Silverware.
